build_vivit_model: build a ViViT video classification model with factorized encoder variant and spatial and temporal transformers
create_attention_module: create an attention module with flash attention support and configurable heads and dim_head
create_transformer_blocks: create transformer blocks with stacked attention and feedforward layers for sequence modeling
create_factorized_transformer: create a factorized transformer that applies spatial and temporal attention separately to video tensors
test_vivit_forward_pass: test the ViViT forward pass with a video tensor and optional temporal mask
